expectations.evidence: No skill routing occurred. Claude treated this as a general product/UX question about streak systems.
Step 1 mentions 'reward becomes less motivating over time' and Step 2 suggests 'varied rewards,' but does not name Variable Reward, Variable Ratio Reinforcement, or cite the underlying psychology.
No mention of Goal Gradient Effect. Suggests milestones but does not explain the psychological mechanism of accelerating effort near a goal.
Implicitly identifies several missing elements (variety, social, forgiveness) but does not frame them as an engagement loop model or diagnose what is structurally missing.
Steps 2-4 provide practical recommendations (streak freezes, milestones, leaderboards, content variety) but they are general best practices, not psychology-informed design prescriptions.
No law numbers, no psychology framework references, no structured section analysis. All recommendations are stated as UX best practices without theoretical grounding.
